concept: A slider is a carved channel with a bead in it, the switch's language stretched out. The channel fills with the one blue up to the value, and the thumb is the same lit bead.

root.why: label and value above the channel, the order people read a setting in

head.why: the label at the start and the value at the end of one line

label.why: a visible label that is also the accessible name

value.why: the value in the measured secondary colour, with tabular figures

slider.why: the whole row is a 44px target while the channel is thin

track.why: a carved channel, shade under its top lip and light on its bottom lip

range.why: the filled part spends the one blue, darker at the top where the lip shades it

thumb.why: the switch bead, lit on its upper left, on a short shadow

data-disabled.why: disabled cannot move and uses the shared disabled opacity

hover.why: hover lifts the bead a little closer by growing it slightly

focus-visible.why: keyboard focus draws the shared ring with its halo, visible on any scene

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours drop the carve and the bead, so a real system-colour border keeps the shape

transform.why: the bead grows on hover over the hover curve

default_to_avoid.pattern: a thin grey slider rail with a blue fill and a white dot (Material slider, the browser range input)
default_to_avoid.why_not: a hairline rail on glass has no edge to find, and it shares nothing with Pane's other controls

derivation.consequence: legibility comes from dimming and blurring the backdrop (brightness, blur), never from an opaque tint
derivation.form: the channel is carved by dimming, shade under its top lip, light on its bottom lip

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns almost no colour of its own, only white at opacities, one ink and one blue
derivation.form: the filled part spends the one blue, darker at the top where the lip shades it

derivation.consequence: controls are full pills because they are held in the hand
derivation.form: the channel is a full pill and the thumb the switch's round bead

derivation.consequence: every target is at least 44px in its smaller dimension or has a 44px hit area
derivation.form: the channel is thin to look at but the whole row is a 44px target

variants.reason: A is Switch's material, so a settings pane with switches and sliders reads as one family (P1, P3). B adds scale marks that only help stepped values and clutter continuous ones. C's thin handle is hard to grab and breaks the round bead.
